settings.heading: Three Steps. Zero Fuss.
settings.text: From bathroom sink to lights out in under a minute.

settings.title: 01 Nasal strip
settings.text: A quick wipe so it grips.

settings.title: 02 Peel & apply
settings.text: Center it on your nose and smooth both sides.

settings.title: 03 Mouth tape
settings.text: Press once, lie back. It stays put till morning.
